J101_shell_slots_note: USB shell plated slots intentionally have top paste; factory connector process confirmation is required. They are not treated as DNP/THT-jack no-paste pads.
inset_basis: API 0.1 mil centre/size rounding: centre axis error 1.27 um, half-width error 0.635 um; 3 um inset covers their vector sum. Raw footprint copper/hole identity is checked without this inset separately.
